audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Bildad's second speech: rebuke of Job, trap/net imagery, light extinguished, terrors, disease/death imagery, uprooted memory, and fate of the wicked. Marked as Bildad's speech, not final theology.

verses.restored: Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

familiar.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.restored: How long until you set an end to words? Understand, and afterward we will speak.

familiar.text: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.restored: Why are we counted as beasts, considered stupid in your eyes?

familiar.text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

verses.restored: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you, or rock move from its place?

familiar.text: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

verses.restored: Indeed, the light of the wicked is put out, and the flame of his fire does not shine.

familiar.text: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

verses.restored: Light grows dark in his tent, and his lamp above him is put out.

familiar.text: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

verses.restored: The steps of his strength are narrowed, and his own counsel throws him down.

familiar.text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

verses.restored: For he is sent into a net by his own feet, and he walks on lattice-work.

familiar.text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

verses.restored: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare holds him fast.

familiar.text: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

verses.restored: A rope is hidden for him in the ground, and a trap for him on the path.

familiar.text: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

verses.restored: Terrors frighten him on every side and chase him at his heels.

familiar.text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

verses.restored: His strength is hungry, and calamity is ready at his side.

familiar.text: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

verses.restored: It eats parts of his skin; the firstborn of death eats his limbs.

familiar.text: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

verses.restored: He is torn from his tent, his confidence, and marched to the king of terrors.

familiar.text: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

verses.restored: What is not his dwells in his tent; sulfur is scattered on his dwelling.

familiar.text: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

verses.restored: Below, his roots dry up; above, his branch withers.

familiar.text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

verses.restored: His memory perishes from the earth, and he has no name on the face of the open land.

familiar.text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

verses.restored: He is thrust from light into darkness and driven out of the world.

familiar.text: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.restored: He has no offspring or descendant among his people, and no survivor where he sojourned.

familiar.text: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

verses.restored: Those in the west are appalled at his day, and those in the east are seized with horror.

familiar.text: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

verses.restored: Surely these are the dwellings of the unjust, and this is the place of one who does not know the Divine.

familiar.text: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
